comment: ANCHOR: CATALYST_GRAPH_TYPED_NODES_20261107 — a lifecycle node is an EVENT. A catalyst_events row typed
'other' (classifier fallback, or news_ingestion's legacy keyword pass) names no catalyst, so the graph
does not bind it and the ingest path stops writing it. Guards the served projection's 11,300-of-21,165
untyped nodes from coming back. Listing it schedules nothing.
